answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 67922 Country: Afghanistan Title: What is the ruling if sexual intercourse takes place during fasting? Question: I had inserted my penis into my partners private parts in Ramadan without ejaculation not knowing that it is haram. So shall I return kaffarah or istighfar is enough? Answer ID: 67922 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1056/1078/N=10/1437) If complete glans get into the vagina of your wife and it was done while keeping the fast which was remembered then the fast of both of you came to an end though no discharge took place. In this case, qaza and kaffarah both became wajib on you. Only istighfar is not enough, however both of you should do istighfar with qaza and kaffarah. You should keep sixty fasts continuously as the kaffarah of Ramadan. Thus both of you would keep sixty one fasts each one for missed fast and sixty fasts for kaffarah. وإن جامع المكلف آدمياً مشتهى فى رمضان أداء، .........أو جومع أو توارت الحشفة في أحد السبيلين أنزل أولا ، عمداً ......قضى،.......، وكفر ....... ككفارة المظاهر (الدر المختار مع رد المحتار ، كتاب الصوم ، باب ما يفسد الصوم وما لا يفسده 3: 385-390، ط: مكتبة زكريا ديوبند). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
